- **SaaS Platform Engineering**: Multi-tenant architectures, subscription billing (Stripe), customer portals, and robust REST APIs.

- **AI Automation Workflows**: Practical LLM integrations, document summarization, lead qualification, and automated triage.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps with Flutter, connected to Laravel backends with offline sync.
